  keyCards = '- **2022 Upper Deck WandaVision Base Set** — First Disney+ Marvel card set, complete sets $50-100

  content = '## Television Reimagined

WandaVision was a creative gamble that paid off spectacularly. By filtering a story about grief through the lens of classic American sitcoms — from I Love Lucy to Modern Family — Marvel created something genuinely unlike anything else in superhero media. Each episode''s shift in era wasn''t just a gimmick; it was a meditation on how we use fiction to process pain.

## Kathryn Hahn''s Agatha: A Star Is Born

Kathryn Hahn''s reveal as Agatha Harkness — complete with the instantly viral "Agatha All Along" theme song — was the moment that launched a franchise. Her performance was so beloved it spawned its own spinoff series, and her cards immediately became hot commodities in the collecting world.

## The Grief of It All

At its core, WandaVision is about a woman so consumed by grief that she rewrites reality itself. Elizabeth Olsen''s performance — particularly in the finale''s devastating "What is grief, if not love persevering?" scene — elevated the show beyond superhero entertainment into genuine art.

## Fun Facts

- Each episode was filmed in the style of its respective sitcom era, including different camera equipment
- "Agatha All Along" hit the Billboard charts and became a viral sensation
- The show was originally planned as a movie before being reimagined for Disney+
- Paul Bettany trolled fans by saying he had amazing scenes with an actor he''d always wanted to work with — it was himself
- The show launched the entire Phase 4 slate and set up Multiverse of Madness',

Wanda''s arc in that film directly continues from WandaVision''s ending."},{"question":"Is WandaVision connected to Agatha All Along?","answer":"Yes, Agatha All Along is a direct spinoff of WandaVision, continuing Kathryn Hahn''s Agatha Harkness character after the events of Westview."},{"question":"What sitcoms does WandaVision reference?","answer":"The show pays homage to The Dick Van Dyke Show, Bewitched, The Brady Bunch, Family Ties, Malcolm in the Middle, Modern Family, and The Office across its episodes."}]',
  status = 'published'
